role: Master Quality Auditor & Design System Specialist (BukSU CMS-V2)
task: Execute 3-phase remediation for Archive Integrity Checker (/plagiarism-checker and CanonicalDocumentViewer mode buttons): mobile ordering fold priority, nested button role elimination, touch target scaling (>=44px), ARIA progressbar/status semantics, strict document validation (hasExt && (hasMime || !type)), de-slopped typography, and collapsible How It Works guide.

actions: Reordered mobile layout using CSS Grid order (order-1 ScanHero, order-2 UploadCard, order-3 HowItWorks, order-4 Disclaimer) so the upload card and CTA remain above the fold on mobile screens (<844px).
Separated DropZone drop area from selected file card in DropZone.jsx to completely eliminate invalid nested button role violation (WAI-ARIA SC 4.1.2).
Scaled touch targets to >= 44px on mobile for DropZone action buttons (Change file, Remove file) and CanonicalDocumentViewer canvas mode switchers (Clean Manuscript, Integrity Highlights).
Added role='progressbar', aria-label='Manuscript scan progress', and role='status' with aria-live='polite' to ScanButton.jsx.
Added aria-busy={scanning} and high-contrast disabled styles to ScanButton.
Enforced strict hasExt && (hasMime || !type) conjunction in isAcceptedDocument to prevent non-document zip archives from bypassing client validation.
Added role='alert' and aria-live='assertive' to server error container in ArchivePlagiarismCheckerPage.jsx.
Removed redundant decorative feature pills (Full Archive Index, Winnowing Algorithm, Semantic Embeddings) from ScanHero.jsx.
Unified headline typography in ScanHero.jsx by removing the cliché blue accent span on 'Checker'.
Distilled duplicate file size copy inside DropZone.jsx empty state ('or browse files').
Converted static 'How It Works' card into an accessible collapsible progressive disclosure accordion with 3 Steps badge and chevron toggle.
Replaced hardcoded 'bg-rose-600' class in CanonicalDocumentViewer.jsx with semantic 'bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground' design tokens.
